name: file_write
description: Write a container or live-checkout file, or delete a broker task file with delete true and no content; policy-gated. Source writes use isolated broker work automatically. Files are read from the source checkout (/code) and this session's workspace; other container paths, including runtime data, are refused. Reads without a selector inspect published/container files; pass a returned broker_id for private-source reads. Optional broker_id selects current, new or returned work. Explicit runtime/workspace paths retain their owning tools. Never deploys.

delete.description: true removes the broker task file at path; broker task files only

mode.description: Broker task files only; workspace and container writes must omit it. append adds to existing content; create refuses an existing path; replace confirms a deliberate full replace (a replace that removes most of the file is refused without it).

task_id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Prefer broker_id; do not supply both. Never use a chat session ID here.

broker_id.description: Omit to continue current broker work; new creates independent isolated work in this operation; reuse a returned Broker ID to switch. Session identity is automatic. Never invent an ID.

expected_inputs_sha256.description: Task digest from the latest task read/list/review; required when writing an existing task.

request_id.description: Stable task-write request ID. Reuse only for identical retries; inspect build_work receipt after uncertainty.
